items.title: Jimmy Bertrand Interview, 1959-09-09
items.q: my uncle was Alphonse Fuzan, F-A-R-Z-A-N, Alphonse. He's the first man left out of Biloxi with the first Creole band.

ctx.x: Where were you born? I was born in Deluxe, Mississippi, 1900. Can you give us the exact date? Yes, Tuesday. Oh, you know the day even. I mean, what was my...
Tuesday, and my uncle was Alphonse Fuzan, F-A-R-Z-A-N, Alphonse. He's the first man left out of Biloxi with the first Creole band. Now, that's the old Creole band, the first one with Freddie Kepard.
